_comment: Per-action corrections, keyed by action id (the card id plus its A/B slot, which is exactly how the publisher's sheets label them). Source for every entry below is the publisher's championship-legal English parts lists (v1.02). Those come from the game company, so they outrank both the community database that generated cards.json and an older card scan. Ranges of 0 on a Firing or Projectile action are the community data simply not recording a range at all.

173_B._note: Fire Control Planning. cards.json says 0; OTTO read 6 off the printed card 2026-08-18 — the scan mistook the 6 for a 0. A 0 would have confined a "within Range" aura to its own Large Grid.

180_B._source: GoF v1.021 - the Stealth Movement passive is now a Jump: a Short Movement Action, Range 2, with Airborne Movement

description.en: · Omni-direction Firing · Melee Firing · {Lightning} may make Target Mech switch into Shutdown Stance immediately.

ZHDR-304_A._source: Printed English card scan assets/cards/en/ZHDR-304.webp, read 2026-08-13. The action had NO English at all.

description.en: · When performing a Command Movement, may consume 1 additional Command Token and -2 Movement to drag 1 adjacent Ally Mech or Ally Drone.

ZHDR-304_B._source: Printed English card scan assets/cards/en/ZHDR-304.webp, read 2026-08-13. No English at all, and the Chinese in cards.json is the OLDER variant: it omits the -2 Movement and says 友军单位 (ally unit) where the card says Ally Mech or Ally Drone. The card-level description carries a second, newer Chinese line that does match the print.

_notes.547_A: H2-B "Crisis" II, Full-auto. A Firing action recorded with no range; the list gives 8.

_notes.173_B: P7-A3 "Centurion" Node Core, Fire Control Planning. Passive with no range; the list gives 6. Passives do carry ranges in our data already, so 0 here was missing data rather than 'not applicable'.
_notes.509_A: Type 55 Shield + PC-9K Shotgun (R) (D), Shield Bash. We had 1; the list prints Melee, which is range 0. Everything else on the action matches.
_notes.179_A: PL1 Standard Chassis, Sprint. Movement action recorded with no range; the GoF Chasis sheet gives 4. Found 2026-08-05: these four GoF chassis were the only Moving actions in the whole database at range 0, and with nothing printed the app fell back to the Maneuver Value, so a PL1 Sprint offered 1 Grid instead of 4.
_notes.180_A: PL29 Stealth Chassis, Sprint. Same gap; the list gives 3.
